description:
Serena is a Queiza which take inspiration from mermaids or other merfolk, though they have legs and finlike tails. Unlike the Queizol (Amaya) they very much look more mermaid like which is why I gave her a greener skintone.

My intent is for her to be a mentor-like figure to Svetlanya.
